set.body: Empirically establish where ScalaFIM MVPA reproduces the original MATLAB RSA Toolbox, modern Python rsatoolbox, and PyMVPA. Each version-pinned scenario must declare the estimand and convention mapping, run through public ScalaFIM seams on JVM and Scala.js, compare numeric identity and adversarial laws, measure matched hot-path performance, and record source LOC, ceremony, pain points, unsupported capabilities, and design consequences in a durable ledger. Exact parity, convention-equivalent agreement, intentional divergence, and absent/no-claim are distinct terminal dispositions. No production compatibility layer is permitted.
set.title: EPIC: certify MVPA conformance against RSA Toolbox and PyMVPA
